concerns.text: The Assumptions section (≈ line 140) states the design is *observational* and findings are *associational*, yet the Success Criteria (SC‑001) and several functional requirements (e.g., FR‑010 power analysis targeting a causal effect) assert a *causal* effect of visual detail on false‑memory susceptibility. This contradictory framing redefines the original research question (which was validated as a domain relationship, not a causal claim) and undermines methodological validity.
